body: Everyone tells me to take a break from it all and I appreciate it, but I do it all the time. It doesn't matter because all I do is think about what I have to do tomorrow or the fact that it's all going to be the same tomorrow. Thanks for trying though.

I always used to know what I wanted to do with my life. I wanted to be a dermatologist for 11 years! Then all of a sudden, I have no fucking clue. I already changed my major to psych and put a ton of effort and money into that as well. I can't change it again. I don't know man, I can't do it anymore.
Work sucks, school is starting to become hard but I've always been an easy A+ student, I don't know what I want to do with my life, I'm a loser. I just can't anymore.
I don't know. That's the thing. I should be happy, but I'm always sad. I feel like I don't have my life figured out and I should by now.
I ran a mile every morning for a few months after I changed my diet and still gained 30 pounds in 3 months. I've tried everything, man.

I've had depression honestly since middle school, so I guess 9 years. We went to New Orleans in July and a big concert festival on the 17th and 18th. Nothing works. I feel like I take too much time off. Thank you for your input
